subject: Economics
pacing_note: The IEB publishes no ATP equivalent; term placement and week spans are the DBE ATP pacing carried over as a default. IEB schools set their own pacing — treat weeks as advisory.
assessment_note: DBE SBA programmes, control-test scopes and exam structures are deliberately stripped: IEB assessment is specified by the IEB Subject Assessment Guidelines (see ../exam_guidelines/), which have not been ingested yet. Do not fall back to the CAPS exam_structure for IEB papers.
scope_deltas: SAG-stated content-scope differences vs the CAPS/DBE prescription are recorded in scope_deltas.json in this folder (hand-maintained, SAG-transcribed only; an empty ledger means 'not yet transcribed', never 'no differences').

topics.name: CIRCULAR FLOW
subtopics: Open vs closed economy; role players; injections and leakages; economy in equilibrium
Autonomous consumption; MPC/MPS; the four-sector model
National accounts aggregates and conversions
The multiplier
topics.prior_knowledge: Factors of production, production process, roles of participants in the economy

topics.name: BUSINESS CYCLES
subtopics: Composition and features; explanation/causes; types of business cycles
Government policy: monetary and fiscal policy
The new economic paradigm (smoothing of cycles); features underpinning forecasting
topics.prior_knowledge: National accounts (GDP/GDI/GDE); monetary policy (SARB, interest rates, cash reserves, open-market transactions, moral suasion); fiscal policy

topics.name: PUBLIC SECTOR
subtopics: Composition and necessity of the public sector; problems of provisioning; objectives
Budgets; fiscal policy including the Laffer curve; public sector failure
topics.prior_knowledge: Circular flow, participants in an economy, government structures, fiscal policy

topics.name: INTERNATIONAL TRADE (FOREIGN EXCHANGE MARKETS)
subtopics: Main reasons for international trade; absolute and comparative advantage
Balance of payments; the IMF; correcting surpluses and deficits (disequilibria)
Foreign exchange markets and the establishment of exchange rates
topics.prior_knowledge: Open-economy circular flow, markets, price formation and market dynamics

topics.name: DYNAMICS OF MARKETS: PERFECT MARKETS
subtopics: Perfect competition; the industry vs the individual business
Market structure; output, profits and losses
Competition policies
topics.prior_knowledge: Price formation: demand and supply, their laws, cost and revenue analysis, price elasticity of demand

topics.name: DYNAMICS OF MARKETS: IMPERFECT MARKETS
subtopics: Monopolies, duopolies, oligopolies, monopolistic competition
Market structures of imperfect competition
topics.prior_knowledge: The market; cost and revenue analysis; price elasticity of demand theory

topics.name: DYNAMICS OF MARKETS: MARKET FAILURES
subtopics: Concept and causes of market failure; misallocation of resources
Consequences of market failures
Cost-benefit analysis (conserving vs using resources; public vs private expenditure)
topics.prior_knowledge: The market, competition, PPC (efficiencies and inefficiencies), public sector intervention

topics.name: INTERNATIONAL TRADE POLICIES (PROTECTIONISM & FREE TRADE)
subtopics: Protection and free trade; globalisation; major protocols
Export promotion; import substitution; arguments for and against free trade; desirable policy mix
Trade liberalisation and the WTO; forms of economic integration
topics.prior_knowledge: Economic systems, four-sector model, north/south divide (Gr 11), absolute and comparative advantage, AU/SADC/NEPAD

topics.name: ECONOMIC GROWTH AND DEVELOPMENT
subtopics: Economic growth vs economic development
Demand-side and supply-side approaches; evaluation of the approaches
SA endeavours; the north/south divide
topics.prior_knowledge: Wealth, scarcity, means of production, income inequality, growth and development, unemployment; monetary and fiscal policy; globalisation

topics.name: ECONOMIC GROWTH AND DEVELOPMENT
subtopics: Economic growth vs economic development
Demand-side and supply-side approaches; evaluation
SA endeavours; the north/south divide

topics.name: GROWTH & DEV: INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT
subtopics: Industrial development; regional development
SA endeavours and the appropriateness of SA strategies
topics.prior_knowledge: SA regional landscape; SA's role and economic importance in Africa; AU and SADC

topics.name: ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL INDICATORS
subtopics: Performance of the economy; economic indicators; money supply and interest rates
Social indicators and international comparisons
Globalisation: IMF and World Bank
topics.prior_knowledge: Growth and development strategies and comparisons; money supply; money and banking; interest rates; globalisation

topics.name: ECONOMIC ISSUES OF THE DAY: INFLATION
subtopics: Inflation concept, types, causes and consequences
The inflation problem in SA and measures to combat inflation
topics.prior_knowledge: Price formation (laws of demand/supply, AD/AS shifts, Phillips curve); monetary and fiscal policy; consumer vs producer inflation

topics.name: ECONOMIC ISSUES OF THE DAY: TOURISM
subtopics: Tourism concept; reasons for growth; effects and benefits
SA tourism profile (incl. IKS); policy suggestions
topics.prior_knowledge: Growth and development, unemployment, poverty, population and labour force; IKS (Gr 11)

topics.name: ECONOMIC ISSUES OF THE DAY: ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY
subtopics: Environmental sustainability; the state of the environment
Measures to ensure sustainability; international measures and agreements (incl. recent ones)
topics.prior_knowledge: Basic economic problem; human rights; economic redress (Gr 11); production possibilities; public sector involvement

topics.name: REVISION: MICRO-ECONOMICS & CONTEMPORARY ECONOMIC ISSUES (PAPER 2 SCOPE)
